Playbook Automation

The automated execution of predefined incident response actions and workflows using orchestration tools, reducing manual intervention and response time in SOC operations.

Questions and answers

What is Playbook Automation?

In this glossary, Playbook Automation refers to: The automated execution of predefined incident response actions and workflows using orchestration tools, reducing manual intervention and response time in SOC operations.

How is Playbook Automation used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Playbook automation allowed the SOC to immediately quarantine compromised endpoints and notify IT without human delay."

Playbook Automation matters because it supports clear communication in SOC contexts for SOC Analysts, Security Engineers, and Incident Responders. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and CEH.
